title: The finite key effect of side-channel-secure quantum key distribution beyond post-selection technique
summary: By applying the framework of entropic uncertainty relation (EUR) and the Quantum Leftover Hash Lemma (QLHL), we introduce a security-proof method for variable-length side-channel-secure (SCS) quantum key distribution (QKD) against coherent attacks. This method reframes composable security as a statistical fluctuation problem of phase errors, enabling direct proofs against coherent attacks through observables and virtual observables.
